title: Cathode passivation suppression enables ultrastable industry-leading alkaline water electrolysis at hundred-ampere currents
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,10514-10522
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04506A, Paper
Yang Wu, Zhenhui Kou, Nengji Liu, Senlin Chu, Bin Yang, Zhongjian Li, Juan Shang, Fei Song, Qinghua Zhang, Peng Liao, Youxiao Chen, Lecheng Lei, Yang Hou
Ru nanoparticles reconstruct water networks on RANEY® Ni, decreasing local pH near cathode to inhibit passivation. The cathode achieves 10 A cm−2 at 2.3 V with 2500 hours stability at 1.0 A cm−2.
